subject: How to remove unneeded Cpp DLL libs

messages.author: df1e8c4ee64c5304
messages.subject: How to remove unneeded Cpp DLL libs
parts:
Good morning, STAN users:

I happened to run objects(all = T) in my test R working space, and I found a whole bunch of Cpp DLL libs for STAN models that I had run. 

".__C__Rcpp_stan_fit4model12f8124d12df_blockerb" 
 [2] ".__C__Rcpp_stan_fit4model12f821be6697_blocker1a"
 [3] ".__C__Rcpp_stan_fit4model12f82c7528b_blocker1b" 
 [4] ".__C__Rcpp_stan_fit4model12f8358d2a95_blockerb" 
 [5] ".__C__Rcpp_stan_fit4model12f839272df5_blocker1a"
 [6] ".__C__Rcpp_stan_fit4model12f87c6c4019_blockerb" 

I don't need these anymore.  Deleting the relevant STAN model fits didn't change this.  I suspect that they are part of the reason that my STAN test space takes so long to load.

How can I delete these?

Thanks in advance for your help on this.

Larry Hunsicker

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: How to remove unneeded Cpp DLL libs
parts:
There is a dyn.unload(x) function in R where
      x: a character string giving the pathname to a DLL, also known
          as a dynamic shared object.
So, you can use that to unload those DLLs. But I don't think it will make any difference.

Ben
